# 

> The IDE host of the lease core: opening a project acquires its
> lease and materializes its git state; being fenced by a takeover
> elsewhere saves open documents and closes the project; sibling
> pushes to remote remotes abort in the push dialog. Ships as a zip
> bundling this jar and ike-lease-core under lib/.
